s1.desc: an igloo entryway with a wooden front door

spans.view: with the door standing open onto snowy pines and a small white bench against the ice-brick wall

beats.text: Polly steps in through the open door carrying a red handbag, her eyes closed
Polly sets the red handbag down on the little bench beside the door
Polly waddles off to the left with her eyes closed, leaving the door open behind her
Pax steps in through the doorway wearing a black necktie while Polly keeps waddling left
Pax tosses a set of keys onto the bench beside the handbag while Polly waddles out on the left
Pax tugs at the knot of his black necktie with both flippers
Pax closes his eyes and slips the loosened necktie forward off his neck into his flippers
Pax shuffles a step to the left with his eyes closed, holding the necktie against his chest in both flippers

spans.notes: slow push-in through the whole shot: phase correlation on the ice-brick wall band (y 0-0.32) drifts steadily up ~0.6 px per frame (-50 px by f81, dx ~0); the door's brown mask (full res) widens steadily from 154 to 163 px with its left edge fixed and its top rising from y 702 to 682 (f0 -> f83, every 6th frame); compare 0/83 shows doubled door and wall edges. ECC on the door-top band fails (characters cross it). No static run. The necktie comes off f66-76, fewer than 21 frames before the end, so it is not listed in outfit; the beats say when (curator ruling on outfits taken off mid-shot). The handbag has no charm. No overlay in the top third or bottom fifth.
